title: Everyday Transformation · Classic
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Everyday Transformation · Classic with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Choose a familiar change such as waking up or getting ready to go out. The lead silently shows the beginning and end of the change in two poses. The group identifies the intended change. Each player takes two turns. Give the lead one point for each successful turn. Highest score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: None.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Everyday Transformation, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The group identifies the intended change.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
recall.why: The group identifies the intended change.
